As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

crossRefs.keyword: giveth a right answer. Heb. answereth right words

translations.web: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
translations.bsb: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips.
translations.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
translations.asv: He kisseth the lips Who giveth a right answer.
